newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 4.568 bln reais in Treasury papers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 4.568 bln reais in Treasury papers.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of the National Treasury, raised 4.568 billion reais during an auction Monday of two series of National Treasury Letters known as LTNs, dealers said.
A total of 3.174 billon reais of 184-day LTNs, due in January 15, 1998, was sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.263 percent a month.
The Central Bank also sold 1.394 billion reais of 365-day, due in July 15 1998, at a call money rate of 2.379 percent a month.
